profile.headline: Retired Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Retired Software Engineer
•	Programming in C, C++, Fortran, ADA, Java, and Python.
•	Embedded software development with Windriver and Green Hills Software Development Environments.
•	Satellite Flight and Ground software development
•	Configuration management with Concurrent Version System and Mercurial 
•	Managing a two person software support team for the systems analysis branch at NASA Ames
•	Unix system administrator for seven years  
•	Modeling geometry and analyzing aerodynamics of aircraft and spacecraft
•	Inactive Secret Clearance

Specialties: C++, C, Python, Java, ADA

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As flight software engineer from July 2007 to November 2016, wrote and maintained ADA and C++ code for satellite flight software. Wrote tools in Java or C++ to help generate database dependent flight software. Develop patches for current flight software as needed.

From November 2016 to February 2019, as a Ground Software Engineer, write and maintain code for ground system software to archive and view satellite data.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded Software Engineer, Northrop Grumman Corporation 	2005 to 2007

•	Developed embedded software in “C” for Radar Warning Receivers using Windriver Tornado and Workbench on a Windows platform
•	Participated in formal software development processes (requirements, design, coding, testing, reviews) for several programs .
•	Managed software configuration with Rational Clearcase.
•	Performed software unit and integration testing

positions.title: Computer System Technologist
positions.description:
* Ported two IRIX GL software programs  to OpenGL allowing more use of the programs.
* Developed an aircraft modeling software package in C++ using Open Cascade. 
* Developed software in C++ for the Thermal Protection System Advanced Engineering Environment tool set.
* Supported the Hypersonic Aerospace Vehicle Optimization Code: developed software and debugged software.
* Developed software to find the aerothermal data at a point on the aircraft.   
* Modeled the aircraft geometry for the X33, the Reusuable Launch Vehicle, the Anser, the Bantam, the Stargazer, and a Single Stage To Orbit vehicles before the deadlines.
* Task manager:  wrote  six task plans, wrote task monthlies, and attended management training seminars.  Received two discretionary bonuses for my work as task manager.
* System administrator for SGI computers and one Sun computer.  Kept the systems running smoothly without impacting the up time of the computers for the users and with no security break-ins.

positions.title: Software Specialist
positions.description:
* Integrated an enhanced super ellipse geometric modeling package into the Hypersonic Aerospace Vehicle
Optimization Code which allowed for more accurate geometric modeling of aircraft. 
* Developed semi-automatic aircraft component packing package for the Hypersonic Aerospace Vehicle Optimization
Code which increased the speed of the packing analysis.
* Contributed C++ code to  two dimensional plotting program which was used extensively by the Systems Analysis
branch users to produce plots for presentations and technical reports.
* Modeled vehicle geometry and packed vehicles for roughly 25 hypersonic vehicle studies without missing a deadline.
* System administrator for eighteen to twenty SGI computers and one Sun computer for 4 years.

honors.title: NASA Software Release Award for TPSSZR-Vehicle TPS Sizing Program Using Sinda/Fluint

volunteerExperiences.description: I have lead hikes since 1993 when I met the qualifications to be a certified hike leader (first aid, co-leading hikes, joining the Sierra Club, etc.).  I have also served on the board of a local section as chair, outings chair, treasurer, secretary, newsletter chair, and IT chair.
I deliver library books once a month to a home bound library patron.
